literal_meaning: ফেলে ছড়ানো বা নিক্ষেপ করে ছড়ানো
figurative_meaning_en: to misuse or squander; to throw or distribute carelessly and indiscriminately
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের বাড়িতে খাবার ফেলাছড়া করে পরিবেশন করা হয়েছে।
সে তার সম্পত্তি ফেলাছড়া করে নষ্ট করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Food was served by throwing and scattering at the wedding house.
He is squandering his property by throwing it around carelessly.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali wedding practices where food, especially sweets or rice, is distributed by handfuls scattered among guests, symbolizing abundance but often leading to waste.
note: Variants reflect regional pronunciations in spoken Bengali.
